keys.help: another field of the table, whose writer it keeps: the factory writes into it who wrote that field each time it is written, and nobody writes it themselves
keys.name: writer_of

keys.help: the name of the icon its column is drawn with, until somebody who looks at the table chooses another
keys.name: icon

keys.help: what giving it a value takes beside what changing the record does: a scope, or a list of scopes every one of which is asked, or for a choice or a flag the scopes of each value that takes any, or `each` for a list of scopes that the record gives somebody, where adding the record or changing anything of it takes holding each scope it then says
keys.name: takes

within.each: a value of the field as it is written, with the scope, or the list of scopes, giving the field that value takes

keys.help: with `takes: each`, the scopes such a list stands for where a record leaves it empty; of a choice, the one word of `of` nothing chosen stands for, which is where nothing ranks and what a number written before the field was a choice is counted from
keys.name: unsaid

keys.help: with `takes`, what giving it its value took is asked again of whoever adds the record or changes any cell of it, for as long as it says that value: for a cell that lets something with more authority do more, beside cells that say what that does
keys.name: stands

args.help: with `declaring`: `false` where the table made is one whose rows are written only by the commands and blueprints that keep it, as `collection.ensure` takes it; said of a table that is there already it changes nothing
args.name: by_hand

example:
blueprint: visitor-kept
permissions: [records:write]

on:
  seen:
    event: visitor.seen
    outside: true
    do: record.add
    with: { collection: visitors, fields: { name: "${event.data.name}" } }
name: record.add
outputs: what it holds, each field by its name
summary: Add a record to a collection a blueprint declared: a sprint, a release, whatever the project keeps.

args.help: the record
args.name: id

args.help: what to say
args.name: body

args.help: mark it public: it is private unless this says so, and what is private is told to nobody outside the factory by whatever keeps the record somewhere else as well
args.name: public

args.help: the words of a document it is about, where it is about a few of them and not the whole document
args.name: anchor

keys.help: the words commented on, as they read in the document, on one line
keys.name: quote

keys.help: a few words just before them in the same block, so that the same words said twice are told apart
keys.name: before

keys.help: a few words just after them in the same block
keys.name: after

keys.help: the headings the block stands under, outermost first, so that words that moved are looked for there first
keys.name: under

example:
blueprint: said-on-a-card

params:
  card: { type: string, description: The card to say something on. }

steps:
  said:
    do: record.comment
    with: { id: "${params.card}", body: The tests pass on this one. }
name: record.comment
outputs: the collection it is a record of
summary: Say something on a record, a card included; it is kept in the record's history and changes nothing of it. Needs `board:write` for a card, `records:write` for any other.

args.help: what the comparison is called: a word, such as `models`
args.name: name

args.help: the blueprint whose starts name it
args.name: of

args.help: its ways, each a mapping (or a word, for a way that is the work as it is written)
args.name: ways

keys.help: what the way is called: a word, such as `otter`, which a start names as its `way`
keys.name: name

keys.help: its part of the things where they are shared out; a start that names its way is given it whatever the shares (default 1)
keys.name: share

keys.help: a blueprint started in place of the one compared
keys.name: blueprint

keys.help: the version of what it starts that it is held to
keys.name: version

keys.help: what it hands, over what the start hands
keys.name: with

keys.help: for a file a step links, by its name in the library, the file it reads instead
keys.name: prompts

args.help: the param that says which thing a start is for; else its place in the tree
args.name: per

args.help: blueprints started for the same things that are measured with each thing's way
args.name: also

args.help: the param that says which thing a start of one of `also` is for, where it is another than `per`
args.name: also_per

args.help: the events about its things that are counted
args.name: counts

keys.help: what the count is called: a lowercase word, such as `judged`
keys.name: name

keys.help: the event's topic, whole
keys.name: topic

keys.help: the field of the event that says which thing it is about; a dotted path reads within it
keys.name: thing

keys.help: the fields whose values say what it came to, each read as `thing` is; the last word of the topic where none
keys.name: by

keys.help: what it came to that says the thing was accepted (the last of several fields where several say); a thing is counted as accepted once
keys.name: accepts

example:
blueprint: two-ways
permissions: [blueprints:run]

steps:
  compared:
    do: compare.start
    with: { name: tones, of: std/run, ways: [loud, quiet] }
name: compare.start
outputs: the names of its ways, as it now has them
true where it had ended, and was answered as it is
summary: Start a comparison whose ways are named by the start, or answer the one there is of that name with the ways asked for added: from now, a start of `of` here whose params say `compared` and `way` goes that way and is measured with it.
